def verified_artifact(directory: Path, relative_path: str, expected_sha256: str, role: str) -> Path:
    path = directory / relative_path
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{role} is missing: {path}")
    if sha256_of(path) != expected_sha256:
        fail(f"{role} {path} does not match its recorded sha256 (artifact changed after capture)")
    return path


def load_final_run(manifest_path: Path, repository_root: Path) -> dict:
    if not manifest_path.is_file():
        fail(f"final-run manifest is missing: {manifest_path}")
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    output = repository_root / "output.csv"
    if not output.is_file() or sha256_of(output) != manifest["output_sha256"]:
        fail(f"{output} does not match the selected final run {manifest['run_id']} (sha256 differs or file missing)")
    for role in ("diagnostics", "usage_ledger"):
        if not (repository_root / manifest[role]).is_file():
            fail(f"final-run {role} is missing: {repository_root / manifest[role]}")
    output_case_ids = set(score.read_rows(output))
    diagnostics = score.read_diagnostics(repository_root / manifest["diagnostics"])
    if set(diagnostics) != output_case_ids:
        fail("final-run diagnostics do not cover exactly the output's case ids")
    return {"manifest": manifest, "output": output, "diagnostics": diagnostics,
            "usage_rows": load_rows(repository_root / manifest["usage_ledger"])}


def load_evaluation_inputs(inputs_path: Path, gold: dict) -> dict:
    if not inputs_path.is_file():
        fail(f"evaluation inputs are missing: {inputs_path} (run code/evaluation/capture_inputs.py)")
    inputs = json.loads(inputs_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    directory = inputs_path.parent
    if "default" not in inputs.get("sample_runs", {}):
        fail("evaluation inputs have no default sample run (required)")
    runs = {}
    for name, entry in sorted(inputs["sample_runs"].items()):
        if SAMPLE_CONFIGURATIONS.get(name) != entry["pipeline_args"]:
            fail(f"sample run {name!r} declares {entry['pipeline_args']}, expected {SAMPLE_CONFIGURATIONS.get(name)}")
        predictions = score.read_rows(verified_artifact(directory, entry["predictions"], entry["predictions_sha256"],
                                                        f"{name} predictions"))
        diagnostics = score.read_diagnostics(verified_artifact(directory, entry["diagnostics"],
                                                               entry["diagnostics_sha256"], f"{name} diagnostics"))
        if set(predictions) != set(gold) or set(diagnostics) != set(gold):
            fail(f"{name} predictions/diagnostics do not cover exactly the {len(gold)} sample case ids")
        runs[name] = {"predictions": predictions, "diagnostics": diagnostics, "model_calls": entry.get("model_calls")}
    custom_entry = inputs.get("custom_results") or fail("evaluation inputs have no custom results (required)")
    custom = json.loads(verified_artifact(directory, custom_entry["path"], custom_entry["sha256"],
                                          "custom results").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    discovery = None
    if inputs.get("discovery_report"):
        entry = inputs["discovery_report"]
        discovery = json.loads(verified_artifact(directory, entry["path"], entry["sha256"],
                                                 "discovery report").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return {**inputs, "runs": runs, "custom": custom, "discovery": discovery, "path": inputs_path}


def metric_row(label: str, result: dict) -> list[str]:
    t = result["totals"]
    return [label, f"{result['status_accuracy']:.3f} ({t.get('status_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']})",
            f"{result['account_linkage'].get('correct', 0)}/{result['cases']}",
            f"{result['step_precision']:.3f} / {result['step_recall']:.3f} / {result['step_f1']:.3f}",
            f"{result['field_accuracy']['evidence_id']:.3f}", f"{result['field_accuracy']['step_no']:.3f}",
            f"{result['sequence_exact']:.3f} ({t.get('sequence_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']})", f"{result['mean_lcs']:.3f}"]


def evidence_mismatches(predictions: dict, gold: dict) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """(matched steps citing different evidence, of which in gold-COMPLETE cases predicted INCOMPLETE)."""
    total = in_unproven_complete = 0
    for case_id, (gold_status, gold_steps) in gold.items():
        predicted_status, predicted_steps = predictions[case_id]
        predicted_by_key = {score.step_key(s): s for s in predicted_steps}
        for step in gold_steps:
            other = predicted_by_key.get(score.step_key(step))
            if other is not None and other["evidence_id"] != step["evidence_id"]:
                total += 1
                in_unproven_complete += gold_status == "COMPLETE" and predicted_status == "INCOMPLETE"
    return total, in_unproven_complete


def guessed_link_accuracy(diagnostics: dict, gold: dict) -> str:
    outcomes = Counter()
    for case_id, record in diagnostics.items():
        if record.get("guessed_account"):
            gold_accounts = {s["resource_id"] for s in gold[case_id][1] if s["system_id"] == "account_service"}
            outcomes["right" if record["guessed_account"] in gold_accounts else "wrong"] += 1
    return f"{outcomes['right']} right / {outcomes['wrong']} wrong guesses"


def sample_claims(result: dict, predictions: dict, gold: dict) -> str:
    per_case, t = result["per_case"], result["totals"]
    misses = [c for c in per_case if not c["status_ok"]]
    unproven_complete = [c for c in misses if c["gold"] == "COMPLETE" and c["account"] == "ungrounded"]
    grounded = [c for c in per_case if c["account"] in ("correct", "wrong")]
    grounded_exact = [c for c in grounded if c["sequence_ok"]]
    mismatched, mismatched_unproven = evidence_mismatches(predictions, gold)
    field = result["field_accuracy"]
    return f"""- **Case-level deletion-status accuracy:** {t.get('status_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']} \
({result['status_accuracy']:.3f}). {len(misses)} status misses; {len(unproven_complete)} of them are gold-COMPLETE cases \
whose account has no grounded link (ACCOUNT_UNGROUNDED keeps them INCOMPLETE by contract).
- **Account linkage (separate metric):** {result['account_linkage']} over {result['cases']} cases; precision of grounded \
links {result['account_linkage_precision']:.3f}.
- **Step-level accuracy** on keys (operation, system_id, resource_id): precision {result['step_precision']:.3f} \
({t.get('matched', 0)}/{t.get('pred_steps', 0)} predicted steps), recall {result['step_recall']:.3f} \
({t.get('matched', 0)}/{t.get('gold_steps', 0)} gold steps), F1 {result['step_f1']:.3f}.
- **Field-level accuracy on the {t.get('matched', 0)} matched steps:** phase {field['phase']:.3f}, state \
{field['state']:.3f}, evidence_id {field['evidence_id']:.3f}, step_no {field['step_no']:.3f}. {mismatched} matched steps \
cite different evidence; {mismatched_unproven} of them are in gold-COMPLETE cases predicted INCOMPLETE (future \
verification steps carry an empty evidence_id by contract).
- **Sequence accuracy:** {t.get('sequence_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']} exact ({result['sequence_exact']:.3f}); mean \
normalized LCS {result['mean_lcs']:.3f}. {len(grounded_exact)} of the {len(grounded)} samples with a grounded account \
link have an exactly matching plan.
- Blocker / diagnostic flags (cases): {json.dumps(result['flag_counts'])}."""


def discovery_section(discovery: dict | None) -> str:
    if discovery is None:
        return "_Not measured in this bundle (no discovery report captured)._"
    found, total = map(int, discovery["resource_recall"].split("/"))
    verdict = "met" if found / total >= DISCOVERY_RECALL_TARGET else "**unmet**"
    return f"""End-to-end discovery on the samples (`code/tools/discovery_report.py`; gold is used only to score):
resource recall {discovery['resource_recall']} ({found / total:.1%}; spec 0010 target ≥ {DISCOVERY_RECALL_TARGET:.0%}: \
{verdict}), current accounts {discovery['account_recall']}, other resources {discovery['other_resource_recall']}, \
{discovery['extra_resources']} extra grounded resources, linkage precision {discovery['linkage_precision']}.
Miss causes (participant-visible evidence at each audit_at): {json.dumps(discovery['miss_causes'])}.
See `code/docs/DISCOVERY_GAP_REVIEW.md`."""


def custom_section(custom: dict) -> str:
    results = custom["results"]
    mark = lambda ok: "pass" if ok else "FAIL"
    rows = [[r["case"], r["case_id"], r["expected_status"], r["got_status"], mark(r["status_ok"]), mark(r["steps_ok"]),
             mark(r["flags_ok"]), mark(r["validator_ok"]), " ".join(r["flags"])] for r in results]
    passed = sum(all((r["status_ok"], r["steps_ok"], r["flags_ok"], r["validator_ok"])) for r in results)
    cases = len({r["case"] for r in results})
    return f"""{cases} cases ({len(results)} requests) under `code/evaluation/cases/`, each an overlay on a temporary copy of
`dataset/` with an expected output written from the rules and a rationale README{' (run offline)' if custom.get('offline') else ''}.
{passed}/{len(results)} requests fully pass.

{table(rows, ["case", "request", "expected", "got", "status", "steps", "flags", "validator", "flags seen"])}"""


def tests_section(test_results: list[dict] | None) -> str:
    if not test_results:
        return "_Not measured in this bundle (no recorded test run)._"
    return table([[t["name"], f"`{t['command']}`", t["exit_code"], t["summary"]] for t in test_results],
                 ["Suite", "Command", "Exit code", "Result"])


def evaluation_report(final: dict, inputs: dict, gold: dict, unified: bool) -> str:
    manifest = final["manifest"]
    default = inputs["runs"]["default"]
    splits = {split: score.score(default["predictions"], gold, score.split_case_ids(split, gold), default["diagnostics"])
              for split in ("dev", "holdout", "all")}
    header = ["Run", "Status acc", "Account linkage", "Step P / R / F1", "evidence_id acc", "step_no acc",
              "Sequence exact", "Mean LCS"]
    ablation_rows = []
    for name, label in ABLATION_LABELS.items():
        run = inputs["runs"].get(name)
        if run is None:
            ablation_rows.append([label, "not measured", "", "", "", "", "", ""])
            continue
        row = metric_row(label, score.score(run["predictions"], gold, score.split_case_ids("all", gold),
                                            run["diagnostics"]))
        if name == "ranked-accounts":
            row[2] = f"{row[2]} grounded; {guessed_link_accuracy(run['diagnostics'], gold)}"
        ablation_rows.append(row)
    flags = Counter(f for d in final["diagnostics"].values() for f in d.get("flags", []))
    links = Counter(d["account_link"]["via"] for d in final["diagnostics"].values() if "account_link" in d)
    with final["output"].open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        distribution = Counter(r["deletion_status"] for r in csv.DictReader(handle))
    provenance = ("The evaluation inputs and the final run come from the **same code revision**." if unified else
                  "**NOT a unified release:** the evaluation inputs and the selected final run come from different "
                  "code revisions. Sample metrics below describe the evaluation-input revision, not the code that "
                  "produced the selected output.")
    return f"""# Evaluation report — Ghost Data Still Exists

Built by `python code/evaluation/make_reports.py` from preserved artifacts (no model calls):
- selected final run `{manifest['run_id']}`, code revision `{manifest['git_revision']}`, output sha256 `{manifest['output_sha256']}`;
- evaluation inputs `{inputs['path'].name}` captured {inputs['captured_at']} at code revision `{inputs['code_revision']}`
  (provider keys present: {', '.join(inputs['provider_configuration']['provider_keys_present']) or 'none'}; default sample
  run model calls: {json.dumps(default['model_calls'])}).

{provenance}

**Read this first.** The 32 public samples were inspected while designing the system, so every sample number is a
**regression-set** result, not untouched validation; the dev (20) / holdout (12) split was inspected too. Custom and
metamorphic cases are **custom validation** written around known risks. No untouched holdout exists, and nothing here
measures hidden-answer accuracy.

## 1. Sample regression set (default configuration)

{table([metric_row(f"{split} ({splits[split]['cases']} cases)", splits[split]) for split in ("dev", "holdout", "all")], header)}

{sample_claims(splits['all'], default['predictions'], gold)}

## 2. Discovery coverage

{discovery_section(inputs['discovery'])}

## 3. Custom validation cases (participant-created, not a holdout)

{custom_section(inputs['custom'])}

## 4. Recorded test runs

`code/tests/test_metamorphic.py`: a post-cutoff audit row per subject, shuffled CSV rows and an unrelated user's identity
and evidence leave outputs unchanged; moving `evidence_54` after every audit_at changes only the cases that used it.

{tests_section(inputs.get('test_results'))}

## 5. Ablations (samples, all 32)

{table(ablation_rows, header)}

The deterministic-only run uses the keyword intent check and has no PNG facts or category fallback. The ranked-account
ablation plans the top-ranked guessed account in INCOMPLETE output only and is never the submitted configuration.
Trust-claims injects SUCCESS operational claims as if they were observations. Full-dataset ablations are not measured.

## 6. Selected final run diagnostics ({manifest['rows']} requests)

- Status distribution: {dict(sorted(distribution.items()))}.
- Account link: {dict(sorted(links.items()))} (non-deletion requests have no link).
- Flags: {dict(sorted(flags.items()))}.

## 7. Failures found and improvements made

{HISTORICAL_IMPROVEMENTS}"""


def usage_report(final: dict) -> str:
    manifest, rows = final["manifest"], final["usage_rows"]
    summary = summarize(rows)
    requests = manifest["rows"]
    tasks = defaultdict(Counter)
    for row in rows:
        if not row["cached"]:
            tasks[(row["provider"], row["model"])][row["task"]] += 1

    def cost_cells(cost):
        return ["n/a" if cost is None else f"${cost:.6f}", "n/a" if cost is None else f"${cost / requests:.8f}"]

    lines = []
    for (provider, model), totals in summary["per_model"].items():
        tokens = totals["input_tokens"] + totals["output_tokens"]
        lines.append([provider, model, ", ".join(f"{t} {n}" for t, n in sorted(tasks[(provider, model)].items())),
                      totals["calls"], totals["attempts"], totals["cached_calls"], totals["input_tokens"],
                      totals["output_tokens"], tokens, f"{tokens / requests:.1f}", *cost_cells(totals["cost_usd"])])
    overall = summary["overall"]
    overall_tokens = overall["input_tokens"] + overall["output_tokens"]
    lines.append(["**overall**", "", "", overall["calls"], overall["attempts"], overall["cached_calls"],
                  overall["input_tokens"], overall["output_tokens"], overall_tokens, f"{overall_tokens / requests:.1f}",
                  *cost_cells(overall["cost_usd"])])
    command = " ".join(["python code/main.py", "--cases", manifest["args"]["cases"],
                        *(["--no-cache"] if manifest["args"]["no_cache"] else [])])
    return f"""# Usage report — final full-dataset run

Run `{manifest['run_id']}` (code revision `{manifest['git_revision']}`), the run that produced the selected `output.csv`
(sha256 `{manifest['output_sha256']}`): `{command}` over {requests} requests. Source: usage ledger
`{manifest['usage_ledger']}` (one row per structured call; calls and tokens are reported exactly as recorded).
{'`--no-cache` skips cache reads, so every call below was a real model call.' if manifest['args']['no_cache'] else ''}

{table(lines, ["Provider", "Model", "Calls by task", "Calls", "Attempts (incl. repair)", "Cached", "Input tokens",
               "Output tokens", "Total tokens", "Avg tokens / request", "Est. cost", "Est. cost / request"])}

- Averages divide by all {requests} requests (most requests make one Jev intent call; PNG extraction is 11 calls shared by
  the whole run; Azure is called only when the intent decision table needs adjudication).
- **Costs are estimated and unverified.** No official price page for these model ids was found; the prices come from
  third-party trackers (sources in `code/config/pricing.yaml`). Gemini output tokens include reasoning tokens.

```yaml
{PRICING_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()}
```
"""


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--final-manifest", type=Path, default=EVALUATION_DIR / "final_run" / "manifest.json")
    parser.add_argument("--evaluation-inputs", type=Path, default=None,
                        help="default: the path named by the final manifest's evaluation_inputs field")
    parser.add_argument("--report-output-directory", type=Path, default=EVALUATION_DIR,
                        help="stage reports elsewhere without replacing the selected ones")
    parser.add_argument("--allow-revision-mismatch", action="store_true",
                        help="render a report labelled NOT a unified release when the input revisions differ")
    parser.add_argument("--repository-root", type=Path, default=REPO_ROOT,
                        help="root holding output.csv, dataset/sample_output.csv and the manifest's relative paths")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    final = load_final_run(args.final_manifest, args.repository_root)
    inputs_path = args.evaluation_inputs
    if inputs_path is None:
        if "evaluation_inputs" not in final["manifest"]:
            fail("the final manifest names no evaluation_inputs; pass --evaluation-inputs PATH")
        inputs_path = args.repository_root / final["manifest"]["evaluation_inputs"]
    gold = score.read_rows(args.repository_root / "dataset" / "sample_output.csv")
    inputs = load_evaluation_inputs(inputs_path, gold)
    unified = inputs["code_revision"] == final["manifest"]["git_revision"]
    if not unified and not args.allow_revision_mismatch:
        fail(f"evaluation inputs revision {inputs['code_revision']} != final run revision "
             f"{final['manifest']['git_revision']}; pass --allow-revision-mismatch to stage a report labelled "
             "NOT a unified release")
    args.report_output_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (args.report_output_directory / "evaluation_report.md").write_text(evaluation_report(final, inputs, gold, unified),
                                                                       encoding="utf-8")
    (args.report_output_directory / "usage_report.md").write_text(usage_report(final), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote evaluation_report.md and usage_report.md to {args.report_output_directory}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Render evaluation_report.md and usage_report.md from preserved, hashed artifacts. No model or provider call.

python code/evaluation/make_reports.py [--final-manifest code/evaluation/final_run/manifest.json]
    [--evaluation-inputs PATH/evaluation_inputs.json] [--report-output-directory DIR] [--allow-revision-mismatch]

The final-run manifest names the selected output, diagnostics and usage ledger; the evaluation inputs
(written by capture_inputs.py) name the sample, ablation, custom, discovery and test results with SHA-256 values.
A missing, altered or mismatched input stops the build with an explicit error (exit code 1).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

EVALUATION_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CODE_DIR = EVALUATION_DIR.parent
REPO_ROOT = CODE_DIR.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(CODE_DIR))
sys.path.insert(0, str(EVALUATION_DIR))

import score  # noqa: E402
from capture_inputs import SAMPLE_CONFIGURATIONS  # noqa: E402
from ghostaudit.llm.ledger import load_rows, summarize  # noqa: E402

PRICING_PATH = CODE_DIR / "config" / "pricing.yaml"
DISCOVERY_RECALL_TARGET = 0.85     # spec 0010 acceptance target for sample resource recall
ABLATION_LABELS = {
    "deterministic": "deterministic-only: no model calls (`--offline --no-cache`)",
    "no-history": "no historical identifiers (`--ablate no-history`)",
    "trust-claims": "trust activity claims (`--ablate trust-claims`)",
    "ranked-accounts": "ranked guessed accounts, INCOMPLETE only (`--ungrounded-account-steps ranked`)",
}

HISTORICAL_IMPROVEMENTS = """Recorded at the commit that made each change (sample regression set; "oracle-assisted" = the check was
given the gold resource ids and operations, so it measures a component, not end-to-end discovery):

| Spec / commit | Failure found | Change | Measured effect (as recorded then) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0007 `2cb0e29` | Six log formats; lookup key and resource id sit on different lines of one trace | one line parser per format, records = trace_id groups | sample identifier reach 76/111 |
| 0009 `04c26e4` | PNG screens were unread; decoy company emails visible on screens | Gemini extraction (cached) + regex/identity-universe revalidation | 23 PNG records; none of the 8 unreachable resources appears in a PNG |
| 0010 `f63f611` | `cache_lookup result=miss` inside a trace read as "record absent"; completed reads not counted as presence | infrastructure lines excluded; completed reads count as presence | oracle-assisted state agreement 99 → 104/111, proofs 71 → 75/75 |
| 0012 `14df3a9` | generic snapshots claimed coverage of collections absent from the whole file | coverage only for collections present in that snapshot | no score change; removes an unsupported absence proof |
| 0013 `0623153` | negated requests contain deletion words | keyword check is a cross-check only; disagreements adjudicated by Azure | 10/10 non-deletion requests and 32/32 sample deletions classified correctly |
| 0017 `4f2a05a` | a newer primary-only read or clean record hid an uncleared replica; a newer package of an older read overwrote newer state | state per storage copy, violation wins; observation-time ordering; bundle omissions scoped to their subjects | sample outputs unchanged; full-dataset 3 obligations changed (0 COMPLETE → INCOMPLETE); oracle-assisted state 103/111 |
| 0018 `b0c7f27` | absence satisfied REDACT / ANONYMIZE / retained-backup obligations | separate preservation predicate, REQUIRED_RECORD_MISSING blocker | sample outputs unchanged; 0 full-dataset changes |
| 0019 `52a1854` | 34 sample resources ungrounded | investigation only: no defensible pre-cutoff link exists (`DISCOVERY_GAP_REVIEW.md`) | recall unchanged; the 0010 ≥85% target stays unmet |
| 0020 | reports claimed every grounded sample had an exact plan and depended on ignored `runs/` files | claims derived from per-case scores; hashed evaluation inputs; explicit input errors | this report |
"""


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise SystemExit(f"make_reports: {message}")


def sha256_of(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def table(rows: list[list], header: list[str]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(["| " + " | ".join(header) + " |", "|" + "---|" * len(header),
                      *["| " + " | ".join(map(str, r)) + " |" for r in rows]])


def verified_artifact(directory: Path, relative_path: str, expected_sha256: str, role: str) -> Path:
    path = directory / relative_path
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{role} is missing: {path}")
    if sha256_of(path) != expected_sha256:
        fail(f"{role} {path} does not match its recorded sha256 (artifact changed after capture)")
    return path


def load_final_run(manifest_path: Path, repository_root: Path) -> dict:
    if not manifest_path.is_file():
        fail(f"final-run manifest is missing: {manifest_path}")
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    output = repository_root / "output.csv"
    if not output.is_file() or sha256_of(output) != manifest["output_sha256"]:
        fail(f"{output} does not match the selected final run {manifest['run_id']} (sha256 differs or file missing)")
    for role in ("diagnostics", "usage_ledger"):
        if not (repository_root / manifest[role]).is_file():
            fail(f"final-run {role} is missing: {repository_root / manifest[role]}")
    output_case_ids = set(score.read_rows(output))
    diagnostics = score.read_diagnostics(repository_root / manifest["diagnostics"])
    if set(diagnostics) != output_case_ids:
        fail("final-run diagnostics do not cover exactly the output's case ids")
    return {"manifest": manifest, "output": output, "diagnostics": diagnostics,
            "usage_rows": load_rows(repository_root / manifest["usage_ledger"])}


def load_evaluation_inputs(inputs_path: Path, gold: dict) -> dict:
    if not inputs_path.is_file():
        fail(f"evaluation inputs are missing: {inputs_path} (run code/evaluation/capture_inputs.py)")
    inputs = json.loads(inputs_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    directory = inputs_path.parent
    if "default" not in inputs.get("sample_runs", {}):
        fail("evaluation inputs have no default sample run (required)")
    runs = {}
    for name, entry in sorted(inputs["sample_runs"].items()):
        if SAMPLE_CONFIGURATIONS.get(name) != entry["pipeline_args"]:
            fail(f"sample run {name!r} declares {entry['pipeline_args']}, expected {SAMPLE_CONFIGURATIONS.get(name)}")
        predictions = score.read_rows(verified_artifact(directory, entry["predictions"], entry["predictions_sha256"],
                                                        f"{name} predictions"))
        diagnostics = score.read_diagnostics(verified_artifact(directory, entry["diagnostics"],
                                                               entry["diagnostics_sha256"], f"{name} diagnostics"))
        if set(predictions) != set(gold) or set(diagnostics) != set(gold):
            fail(f"{name} predictions/diagnostics do not cover exactly the {len(gold)} sample case ids")
        runs[name] = {"predictions": predictions, "diagnostics": diagnostics, "model_calls": entry.get("model_calls")}
    custom_entry = inputs.get("custom_results") or fail("evaluation inputs have no custom results (required)")
    custom = json.loads(verified_artifact(directory, custom_entry["path"], custom_entry["sha256"],
                                          "custom results").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    discovery = None
    if inputs.get("discovery_report"):
        entry = inputs["discovery_report"]
        discovery = json.loads(verified_artifact(directory, entry["path"], entry["sha256"],
                                                 "discovery report").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return {**inputs, "runs": runs, "custom": custom, "discovery": discovery, "path": inputs_path}


def metric_row(label: str, result: dict) -> list[str]:
    t = result["totals"]
    return [label, f"{result['status_accuracy']:.3f} ({t.get('status_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']})",
            f"{result['account_linkage'].get('correct', 0)}/{result['cases']}",
            f"{result['step_precision']:.3f} / {result['step_recall']:.3f} / {result['step_f1']:.3f}",
            f"{result['field_accuracy']['evidence_id']:.3f}", f"{result['field_accuracy']['step_no']:.3f}",
            f"{result['sequence_exact']:.3f} ({t.get('sequence_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']})", f"{result['mean_lcs']:.3f}"]


def evidence_mismatches(predictions: dict, gold: dict) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """(matched steps citing different evidence, of which in gold-COMPLETE cases predicted INCOMPLETE)."""
    total = in_unproven_complete = 0
    for case_id, (gold_status, gold_steps) in gold.items():
        predicted_status, predicted_steps = predictions[case_id]
        predicted_by_key = {score.step_key(s): s for s in predicted_steps}
        for step in gold_steps:
            other = predicted_by_key.get(score.step_key(step))
            if other is not None and other["evidence_id"] != step["evidence_id"]:
                total += 1
                in_unproven_complete += gold_status == "COMPLETE" and predicted_status == "INCOMPLETE"
    return total, in_unproven_complete


def guessed_link_accuracy(diagnostics: dict, gold: dict) -> str:
    outcomes = Counter()
    for case_id, record in diagnostics.items():
        if record.get("guessed_account"):
            gold_accounts = {s["resource_id"] for s in gold[case_id][1] if s["system_id"] == "account_service"}
            outcomes["right" if record["guessed_account"] in gold_accounts else "wrong"] += 1
    return f"{outcomes['right']} right / {outcomes['wrong']} wrong guesses"


def sample_claims(result: dict, predictions: dict, gold: dict) -> str:
    per_case, t = result["per_case"], result["totals"]
    misses = [c for c in per_case if not c["status_ok"]]
    unproven_complete = [c for c in misses if c["gold"] == "COMPLETE" and c["account"] == "ungrounded"]
    grounded = [c for c in per_case if c["account"] in ("correct", "wrong")]
    grounded_exact = [c for c in grounded if c["sequence_ok"]]
    mismatched, mismatched_unproven = evidence_mismatches(predictions, gold)
    field = result["field_accuracy"]
    return f"""- **Case-level deletion-status accuracy:** {t.get('status_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']} \
({result['status_accuracy']:.3f}). {len(misses)} status misses; {len(unproven_complete)} of them are gold-COMPLETE cases \
whose account has no grounded link (ACCOUNT_UNGROUNDED keeps them INCOMPLETE by contract).
- **Account linkage (separate metric):** {result['account_linkage']} over {result['cases']} cases; precision of grounded \
links {result['account_linkage_precision']:.3f}.
- **Step-level accuracy** on keys (operation, system_id, resource_id): precision {result['step_precision']:.3f} \
({t.get('matched', 0)}/{t.get('pred_steps', 0)} predicted steps), recall {result['step_recall']:.3f} \
({t.get('matched', 0)}/{t.get('gold_steps', 0)} gold steps), F1 {result['step_f1']:.3f}.
- **Field-level accuracy on the {t.get('matched', 0)} matched steps:** phase {field['phase']:.3f}, state \
{field['state']:.3f}, evidence_id {field['evidence_id']:.3f}, step_no {field['step_no']:.3f}. {mismatched} matched steps \
cite different evidence; {mismatched_unproven} of them are in gold-COMPLETE cases predicted INCOMPLETE (future \
verification steps carry an empty evidence_id by contract).
- **Sequence accuracy:** {t.get('sequence_ok', 0)}/{result['cases']} exact ({result['sequence_exact']:.3f}); mean \
normalized LCS {result['mean_lcs']:.3f}. {len(grounded_exact)} of the {len(grounded)} samples with a grounded account \
link have an exactly matching plan.
- Blocker / diagnostic flags (cases): {json.dumps(result['flag_counts'])}."""


def discovery_section(discovery: dict | None) -> str:
    if discovery is None:
        return "_Not measured in this bundle (no discovery report captured)._"
    found, total = map(int, discovery["resource_recall"].split("/"))
    verdict = "met" if found / total >= DISCOVERY_RECALL_TARGET else "**unmet**"
    return f"""End-to-end discovery on the samples (`code/tools/discovery_report.py`; gold is used only to score):
resource recall {discovery['resource_recall']} ({found / total:.1%}; spec 0010 target ≥ {DISCOVERY_RECALL_TARGET:.0%}: \
{verdict}), current accounts {discovery['account_recall']}, other resources {discovery['other_resource_recall']}, \
{discovery['extra_resources']} extra grounded resources, linkage precision {discovery['linkage_precision']}.
Miss causes (participant-visible evidence at each audit_at): {json.dumps(discovery['miss_causes'])}.
See `code/docs/DISCOVERY_GAP_REVIEW.md`."""


def custom_section(custom: dict) -> str:
    results = custom["results"]
    mark = lambda ok: "pass" if ok else "FAIL"
    rows = [[r["case"], r["case_id"], r["expected_status"], r["got_status"], mark(r["status_ok"]), mark(r["steps_ok"]),
             mark(r["flags_ok"]), mark(r["validator_ok"]), " ".join(r["flags"])] for r in results]
    passed = sum(all((r["status_ok"], r["steps_ok"], r["flags_ok"], r["validator_ok"])) for r in results)
    cases = len({r["case"] for r in results})
    return f"""{cases} cases ({len(results)} requests) under `code/evaluation/cases/`, each an overlay on a temporary copy of
`dataset/` with an expected output written from the rules and a rationale README{' (run offline)' if custom.get('offline') else ''}.
{passed}/{len(results)} requests fully pass.

{table(rows, ["case", "request", "expected", "got", "status", "steps", "flags", "validator", "flags seen"])}"""


def tests_section(test_results: list[dict] | None) -> str:
    if not test_results:
        return "_Not measured in this bundle (no recorded test run)._"
    return table([[t["name"], f"`{t['command']}`", t["exit_code"], t["summary"]] for t in test_results],
                 ["Suite", "Command", "Exit code", "Result"])


def evaluation_report(final: dict, inputs: dict, gold: dict, unified: bool) -> str:
    manifest = final["manifest"]
    default = inputs["runs"]["default"]
    splits = {split: score.score(default["predictions"], gold, score.split_case_ids(split, gold), default["diagnostics"])
              for split in ("dev", "holdout", "all")}
    header = ["Run", "Status acc", "Account linkage", "Step P / R / F1", "evidence_id acc", "step_no acc",
              "Sequence exact", "Mean LCS"]
    ablation_rows = []
    for name, label in ABLATION_LABELS.items():
        run = inputs["runs"].get(name)
        if run is None:
            ablation_rows.append([label, "not measured", "", "", "", "", "", ""])
            continue
        row = metric_row(label, score.score(run["predictions"], gold, score.split_case_ids("all", gold),
                                            run["diagnostics"]))
        if name == "ranked-accounts":
            row[2] = f"{row[2]} grounded; {guessed_link_accuracy(run['diagnostics'], gold)}"
        ablation_rows.append(row)
    flags = Counter(f for d in final["diagnostics"].values() for f in d.get("flags", []))
    links = Counter(d["account_link"]["via"] for d in final["diagnostics"].values() if "account_link" in d)
    with final["output"].open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        distribution = Counter(r["deletion_status"] for r in csv.DictReader(handle))
    provenance = ("The evaluation inputs and the final run come from the **same code revision**." if unified else
                  "**NOT a unified release:** the evaluation inputs and the selected final run come from different "
                  "code revisions. Sample metrics below describe the evaluation-input revision, not the code that "
                  "produced the selected output.")
    return f"""# Evaluation report — Ghost Data Still Exists

## 1. Sample regression set (default configuration)

{table([metric_row(f"{split} ({splits[split]['cases']} cases)", splits[split]) for split in ("dev", "holdout", "all")], header)}

{HISTORICAL_IMPROVEMENTS}"""


def usage_report(final: dict) -> str:
    manifest, rows = final["manifest"], final["usage_rows"]
    summary = summarize(rows)
    requests = manifest["rows"]
    tasks = defaultdict(Counter)
    for row in rows:
        if not row["cached"]:
            tasks[(row["provider"], row["model"])][row["task"]] += 1

    def cost_cells(cost):
        return ["n/a" if cost is None else f"${cost:.6f}", "n/a" if cost is None else f"${cost / requests:.8f}"]

    lines = []
    for (provider, model), totals in summary["per_model"].items():
        tokens = totals["input_tokens"] + totals["output_tokens"]
        lines.append([provider, model, ", ".join(f"{t} {n}" for t, n in sorted(tasks[(provider, model)].items())),
                      totals["calls"], totals["attempts"], totals["cached_calls"], totals["input_tokens"],
                      totals["output_tokens"], tokens, f"{tokens / requests:.1f}", *cost_cells(totals["cost_usd"])])
    overall = summary["overall"]
    overall_tokens = overall["input_tokens"] + overall["output_tokens"]
    lines.append(["**overall**", "", "", overall["calls"], overall["attempts"], overall["cached_calls"],
                  overall["input_tokens"], overall["output_tokens"], overall_tokens, f"{overall_tokens / requests:.1f}",
                  *cost_cells(overall["cost_usd"])])
    command = " ".join(["python code/main.py", "--cases", manifest["args"]["cases"],
                        *(["--no-cache"] if manifest["args"]["no_cache"] else [])])
    return f"""# Usage report — final full-dataset run

Run `{manifest['run_id']}` (code revision `{manifest['git_revision']}`), the run that produced the selected `output.csv`
(sha256 `{manifest['output_sha256']}`): `{command}` over {requests} requests. Source: usage ledger
`{manifest['usage_ledger']}` (one row per structured call; calls and tokens are reported exactly as recorded).
{'`--no-cache` skips cache reads, so every call below was a real model call.' if manifest['args']['no_cache'] else ''}

{table(lines, ["Provider", "Model", "Calls by task", "Calls", "Attempts (incl. repair)", "Cached", "Input tokens",
               "Output tokens", "Total tokens", "Avg tokens / request", "Est. cost", "Est. cost / request"])}

- Averages divide by all {requests} requests (most requests make one Jev intent call; PNG extraction is 11 calls shared by
  the whole run; Azure is called only when the intent decision table needs adjudication).
- **Costs are estimated and unverified.** No official price page for these model ids was found; the prices come from
  third-party trackers (sources in `code/config/pricing.yaml`). Gemini output tokens include reasoning tokens.

```yaml
{PRICING_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()}
```
"""


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--final-manifest", type=Path, default=EVALUATION_DIR / "final_run" / "manifest.json")
    parser.add_argument("--evaluation-inputs", type=Path, default=None,
                        help="default: the path named by the final manifest's evaluation_inputs field")
    parser.add_argument("--report-output-directory", type=Path, default=EVALUATION_DIR,
                        help="stage reports elsewhere without replacing the selected ones")
    parser.add_argument("--allow-revision-mismatch", action="store_true",
                        help="render a report labelled NOT a unified release when the input revisions differ")
    parser.add_argument("--repository-root", type=Path, default=REPO_ROOT,
                        help="root holding output.csv, dataset/sample_output.csv and the manifest's relative paths")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    final = load_final_run(args.final_manifest, args.repository_root)
    inputs_path = args.evaluation_inputs
    if inputs_path is None:
        if "evaluation_inputs" not in final["manifest"]:
            fail("the final manifest names no evaluation_inputs; pass --evaluation-inputs PATH")
        inputs_path = args.repository_root / final["manifest"]["evaluation_inputs"]
    gold = score.read_rows(args.repository_root / "dataset" / "sample_output.csv")
    inputs = load_evaluation_inputs(inputs_path, gold)
    unified = inputs["code_revision"] == final["manifest"]["git_revision"]
    if not unified and not args.allow_revision_mismatch:
        fail(f"evaluation inputs revision {inputs['code_revision']} != final run revision "
             f"{final['manifest']['git_revision']}; pass --allow-revision-mismatch to stage a report labelled "
             "NOT a unified release")
    args.report_output_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (args.report_output_directory / "evaluation_report.md").write_text(evaluation_report(final, inputs, gold, unified),
                                                                       encoding="utf-8")
    (args.report_output_directory / "usage_report.md").write_text(usage_report(final), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote evaluation_report.md and usage_report.md to {args.report_output_directory}")

"""Spec 0020: reports rebuild from a preserved fictional bundle through the real CLI, without runs/, caches,
credentials or model access; missing or mismatched inputs fail explicitly; staging leaves selected reports alone."""
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

CODE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MAKE_REPORTS = CODE_DIR / "evaluation" / "make_reports.py"
SPLIT = json.loads((CODE_DIR / "evaluation" / "split.json").read_text())
SAMPLE_CASE_IDS = sorted(SPLIT["dev"] + SPLIT["holdout"], key=lambda c: int(c.split("_")[1]))
GROUNDED = SAMPLE_CASE_IDS[:4]                    # 4 grounded samples ...
NOT_EXACT = set(SAMPLE_CASE_IDS[2:4])             # ... of which 2 lack one step (not exact)
CODE_REVISION = "f" * 40


def account_plan(case_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    account = f"account_{case_id.split('_')[1]}"
    rows = [("FINDING", "REPORT_REMAINING_RECORD", "PRESENT", "evidence_01"),
            ("REMEDIATION", "DELETE_RECORD", "ABSENT", ""), ("VERIFICATION", "VERIFY_RECORD_ABSENT", "ABSENT", "")]
    return [{"step_no": n, "phase": phase, "system_id": "account_service", "resource_id": account, "operation": op,
             "state": state, "evidence_id": evidence} for n, (phase, op, state, evidence) in enumerate(rows, start=1)]


def write_csv(path: Path, rows: list[tuple[str, str, list]]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writerow(["case_id", "deletion_status", "steps_json"])
        writer.writerows([case_id, status, json.dumps(steps)] for case_id, status, steps in rows)


def write_jsonl(path: Path, records: list[dict]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in records), encoding="utf-8")


def sha256_of(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


@pytest.fixture
def bundle(tmp_path):
    root = tmp_path / "repo"
    write_csv(root / "dataset" / "sample_output.csv", [(c, "INCOMPLETE", account_plan(c)) for c in SAMPLE_CASE_IDS])
    write_csv(root / "output.csv", [("case_1", "INCOMPLETE", account_plan("case_1")), ("case_2", "NOT_APPLICABLE", [])])
    final = root / "code" / "evaluation" / "final_run"
    write_jsonl(final / "diagnostics.jsonl", [{"case_id": "case_1", "flags": ["ACCOUNT_UNGROUNDED"],
                                               "account_link": {"via": "ungrounded"}},
                                              {"case_id": "case_2", "flags": []}])
    write_jsonl(final / "usage_ledger.jsonl", [
        {"provider": "jev", "model": "jev-1.14.0", "task": "intent", "input_tokens": 1234, "output_tokens": 5,
         "cached": False, "attempts": 1, "latency_ms": 1}])
    manifest = {"run_id": "fixture_run", "git_revision": CODE_REVISION, "rows": 2,
                "output_sha256": sha256_of(root / "output.csv"), "args": {"cases": "all", "no_cache": True},
                "diagnostics": "code/evaluation/final_run/diagnostics.jsonl",
                "usage_ledger": "code/evaluation/final_run/usage_ledger.jsonl",
                "evaluation_inputs": "code/evaluation/fixture_bundle/evaluation_inputs.json"}
    (final / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest), encoding="utf-8")
    inputs_dir = root / "code" / "evaluation" / "fixture_bundle"
    predictions = [(c, "INCOMPLETE", account_plan(c)[:2] if c in NOT_EXACT else account_plan(c))
                   for c in SAMPLE_CASE_IDS]
    write_csv(inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv", predictions)
    write_jsonl(inputs_dir / "sample_default.diagnostics.jsonl", [
        {"case_id": c, "flags": [] if c in GROUNDED else ["ACCOUNT_UNGROUNDED"],
         "account_link": {"via": "grounded", "current": f"account_{c.split('_')[1]}"} if c in GROUNDED
         else {"via": "ungrounded", "current": None}} for c in SAMPLE_CASE_IDS])
    custom = {"offline": False, "results": [
        {"case": "synthetic_one", "case_id": "case_9001", "expected_status": "COMPLETE", "got_status": "COMPLETE",
         "status_ok": True, "steps_ok": True, "flags_ok": True, "validator_ok": True, "flags": []},
        {"case": "synthetic_two", "case_id": "case_9002", "expected_status": "INCOMPLETE", "got_status": "COMPLETE",
         "status_ok": False, "steps_ok": False, "flags_ok": True, "validator_ok": True, "flags": []}]}
    (inputs_dir / "custom_results.json").write_text(json.dumps(custom), encoding="utf-8")
    inputs = {"code_revision": CODE_REVISION, "captured_at": "2026-10-25T00:00:00Z",
              "provider_configuration": {"provider_keys_present": [], "llm_cache_entries_before_capture": 0},
              "sample_runs": {"default": {"pipeline_args": [], "predictions": "sample_default.csv",
                                          "predictions_sha256": sha256_of(inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv"),
                                          "diagnostics": "sample_default.diagnostics.jsonl",
                                          "diagnostics_sha256": sha256_of(inputs_dir / "sample_default.diagnostics.jsonl"),
                                          "model_calls": {"calls": 0, "cached_calls": 32}}},
              "custom_results": {"path": "custom_results.json", "sha256": sha256_of(inputs_dir / "custom_results.json")},
              "test_results": [{"name": "full_suite", "command": "python -m pytest code/tests -q", "exit_code": 0,
                                "summary": "7 passed"}]}
    write_inputs(inputs_dir, inputs)
    return root, inputs_dir, inputs


def write_inputs(inputs_dir: Path, inputs: dict) -> None:
    (inputs_dir / "evaluation_inputs.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs), encoding="utf-8")


def make_reports(root: Path, *extra: str, output_directory: str = "staged") -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    """The real CLI in a fresh process: no provider credentials, an unusable proxy, cwd without runs/."""
    environment = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
                   if not any(t in k for t in ("API_KEY", "ENDPOINT", "API_BASE", "PROXY", "proxy"))}
    environment["HTTPS_PROXY"] = environment["HTTP_PROXY"] = "http://127.0.0.1:9"
    probe = ("import runpy, sys; sys.argv = sys.argv[1:]; "
             "exit_code = 0\ntry:\n    runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0], run_name='__main__')\n"
             "except SystemExit as stop:\n    exit_code = stop.code if isinstance(stop.code, int) else 1\n"
             "    print(stop, file=sys.stderr)\n"
             "print('provider modules loaded:', sorted(m for m in sys.modules if m.startswith(('strands', "
             "'typesafe_sdk', 'openai', 'google.genai', 'ghostaudit.llm.providers'))))\nsys.exit(exit_code)")
    command = [sys.executable, "-c", probe, str(MAKE_REPORTS), "--repository-root", str(root),
               "--final-manifest", str(root / "code" / "evaluation" / "final_run" / "manifest.json"),
               "--report-output-directory", str(root / output_directory), *extra]
    return subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, env=environment)


def test_rebuild_is_model_free_and_derives_claims_from_the_bundle(bundle):
    root, _, _ = bundle
    completed = make_reports(root)
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
    assert "provider modules loaded: []" in completed.stdout
    assert not (root / "runs").exists()
    report = (root / "staged" / "evaluation_report.md").read_text()
    assert "2 of the 4 samples with a grounded account link have an exactly matching plan" in report
    assert "30/32 exact" in report and "1/2 requests fully pass" in report and "7 passed" in report
    assert "same code revision" in report and "Not measured in this bundle (no discovery report" in report
    usage = (root / "staged" / "usage_report.md").read_text()
    assert "1234" in usage and "estimated and unverified" in usage


def test_staging_leaves_selected_reports_untouched(bundle):
    root, _, _ = bundle
    selected = root / "code" / "evaluation" / "evaluation_report.md"
    selected.write_text("selected report\n")
    assert make_reports(root).returncode == 0
    assert selected.read_text() == "selected report\n" and (root / "staged" / "evaluation_report.md").is_file()


def corrupt_missing_predictions(inputs_dir, inputs):
    (inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv").unlink()


def corrupt_missing_diagnostics(inputs_dir, inputs):
    (inputs_dir / "sample_default.diagnostics.jsonl").unlink()


def corrupt_wrong_hash(inputs_dir, inputs):
    with (inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv").open("a") as handle:
        handle.write("\n")


def corrupt_wrong_coverage(inputs_dir, inputs):
    path = inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv"
    path.write_text("".join(path.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)[:-1]))
    inputs["sample_runs"]["default"]["predictions_sha256"] = sha256_of(path)
    write_inputs(inputs_dir, inputs)


def corrupt_declared_configuration(inputs_dir, inputs):
    inputs["sample_runs"]["default"]["pipeline_args"] = ["--offline"]
    write_inputs(inputs_dir, inputs)


def corrupt_declared_revision(inputs_dir, inputs):
    inputs["code_revision"] = "0" * 40
    write_inputs(inputs_dir, inputs)


def corrupt_missing_custom_results(inputs_dir, inputs):
    (inputs_dir / "custom_results.json").unlink()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("corrupt,message", [
    (corrupt_missing_predictions, "default predictions is missing"),
    (corrupt_missing_diagnostics, "default diagnostics is missing"),
    (corrupt_wrong_hash, "does not match its recorded sha256"),
    (corrupt_wrong_coverage, "do not cover exactly the 32 sample case ids"),
    (corrupt_declared_configuration, "declares ['--offline']"),
    (corrupt_declared_revision, "pass --allow-revision-mismatch"),
    (corrupt_missing_custom_results, "custom results is missing"),
])
def test_missing_or_mismatched_inputs_fail_explicitly(bundle, corrupt, message):
    root, inputs_dir, inputs = bundle
    corrupt(inputs_dir, inputs)
    completed = make_reports(root)
    assert completed.returncode == 1 and message in completed.stderr
    assert not (root / "staged").exists()                                  # nothing misleading is rendered


def test_acknowledged_revision_mismatch_is_labelled(bundle):
    root, inputs_dir, inputs = bundle
    corrupt_declared_revision(inputs_dir, inputs)
    completed = make_reports(root, "--allow-revision-mismatch")
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
    assert "NOT a unified release" in (root / "staged" / "evaluation_report.md").read_text()


def test_altered_selected_output_fails(bundle):
    root, _, _ = bundle
    with (root / "output.csv").open("a") as handle:
        handle.write("\n")
    completed = make_reports(root)
    assert completed.returncode == 1 and "does not match the selected final run" in completed.stderr

+    assert "1234" in usage and "estimated and unverified" in usage
+
+
+def test_staging_leaves_selected_reports_untouched(bundle):
+    root, _, _ = bundle
+    selected = root / "code" / "evaluation" / "evaluation_report.md"

+    assert make_reports(root).returncode == 0
+    assert selected.read_text() == "selected report\n" and (root / "staged" / "evaluation_report.md").is_file()
+
+
+def corrupt_missing_predictions(inputs_dir, inputs):
+    (inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv").unlink()
+
+
+def corrupt_missing_diagnostics(inputs_dir, inputs):
+    (inputs_dir / "sample_default.diagnostics.jsonl").unlink()
+
+
+def corrupt_wrong_hash(inputs_dir, inputs):
+    with (inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv").open("a") as handle:
+        handle.write("\n")
+
+

+    path = inputs_dir / "sample_default.csv"

+    write_inputs(inputs_dir, inputs)
+
+

+    inputs["sample_runs"]["default"]["pipeline_args"] = ["--offline"]
+    write_inputs(inputs_dir, inputs)
+

+def corrupt_declared_revision(inputs_dir, inputs):

  of predictions and diagnostics, declared configurations and the selected output checksum, and exits 1 with an
  actionable message otherwise. Revisions must match unless `--allow-revision-mismatch`, which labels the report
  "NOT a unified release". `--report-output-directory` stages reports without touching the selected ones.
  All narrative numbers are computed from per-case scores (status misses and their cause, grounded vs exact plans,

=== requirements.md
# Spec 0021 — Validated final run and packaging: requirements

**Status:** Not started. **Depends on:** 0020.

## Goal

Produce and publish a corrected final run whose output, proof diagnostics, reports, usage and package agree.

## Acceptance criteria

- Candidate generation/validation must complete before replacing an existing selected output. Failed
  generation, failed validation or interrupted candidate writing must leave the previous selected CSV intact.
- Publish only the default pipeline as the selected output. Keep samples, custom fixtures and ranked-account
  or trust-claims ablations separate; no configuration is selected merely because it has more COMPLETE rows.
- Record the actual producing code revision, input/configuration identities, run ID and output checksum. Do
  not replace the producing revision with a later documentation-only commit or select a manifest by mtime alone.
- Produce exactly 518 unique, ordered request rows with valid steps and eligible citations. Run the validator
  with the matching diagnostics, and explain remaining blockers/warnings rather than labelling them successes.
- The selected output, diagnostics, final-run manifest, usage ledger, evaluation inputs and reports form one
  validated bundle. Missing, stale or mismatched required artifacts prevent ready status.
- Byte-hashed release artifacts must retain their declared bytes across supported checkout platforms. Test
  LF/CRLF handling; do not silently weaken checksum validation or regenerate predictions to fix checkout conversion.
- Rebuild code.zip from the validated tree; inspect required reports/README and exclusions. Verify the runnable
  extracted layout, focused offline checks and report rebuilding without the developer's ignored artifacts.
- Update MORNING_REPORT, SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST and interview notes with actual corrected metrics, provenance,
  limitations, artifact locations and publication status. Do not infer a deadline or submit automatically.
- Commit and push the completed spec, verify publication, and include the actual harness trace checkpoint.

## Boundaries

Use existing runners, serializers, validators, report and packaging functions. A thin finalization command is
allowed to prevent manual mismatches; no new workflow framework, deployment system or storage service is needed.
=== design.md
# Spec 0021 — Validated final run and packaging: design

## Safe output publication

`main.py` currently writes the destination before validation. Stage candidate bytes beside the destination,
finish the relevant diagnostics/manifest, validate against the intended request set, then replace the selected
CSV only after success. Prefer straightforward `Path`/`os.replace` behavior, with cleanup limited to temporary
files owned by this run. A caller must never receive exit 0 for a failed validation. Preserve partial-run
semantics explicitly; a `--case` subset is not a valid replacement for the full submission.

The reviewed Windows checkout normalizes the committed output CSV to CRLF, invalidating its byte hash. Prefer
a narrow Git artifact-storage rule (for example, appropriate `.gitattributes` entries for the hashed release
paths) and consistent writer bytes over a new conversion framework. Verify a clean checkout's artifact hash;
do not define a different checksum calculation silently or conceal a real content mismatch.

Add `--run-manifest-output PATH` (planned) so a release can identify its manifest without guessing the newest
file in `runs/`. Preserve existing defaults/callers. Use a name such as `run_manifest_output_path` internally.

Use a thin `code/tools/finalize_run.py` (planned) accepting `--candidate-manifest PATH` and
`--evaluation-inputs PATH`. Reuse the existing validator, hash checks, 0020 report functions and packaging
conventions. It must:
1. validate the candidate, diagnostics, usage ledger, producing revision/configuration and evaluation inputs;
2. stage the selected-run files and reports, resolving all artifact references from the manifest, not globals;
3. preserve the previous selected bundle until staging/validation succeeds;
4. publish the selected output and tracked `code/evaluation/final_run/` artifacts with relative, reproducible
   paths and recheck consistency; on an interrupted publication, fail visibly with a recoverable run identity
   rather than reporting the bundle ready. Do not claim a multi-file operation is atomic if it is not.

No inference is rerun inside finalization or report rebuilding. The next Git checkpoint records a consistent
bundle; the previously committed release remains the recovery point. Update README with the exact procedure.

## Code freeze, tests and artifacts

- Commit/push an **In progress** runtime checkpoint if source changes in this spec need a producing revision
  before the full run. Record its actual SHA. Do not mark 0021 Completed at that checkpoint.
- Refresh the sample/ablation/custom input bundle through 0020's workflow using this producing code and recorded
  modes, then run the final full dataset once cold-cache. Repeated model runs require a new failure/change reason.
- Add `code/tests/test_run_publication.py` (planned): injected generation/validation/report-staging failures keep
  the old selected output; valid promotion succeeds; subset, wrong-code/config, wrong-hash and missing-diagnostics
   candidates are refused; fake providers keep these tests offline.
- Include a checkout/line-ending regression for the byte-hashed artifact contract, documenting how the test
  controls Git configuration without changing the user's global Git settings.
- Add `code/tests/test_packaging_integrity.py` (planned) only for meaningful archive/rebuild coverage not already
  tested: correct extracted layout, required reports, excluded dataset/secrets/caches, manifest consistency and
  offline report rebuilding. The old package's existence must not be mistaken for a successful new build.
- Keep original measured data labelled with its producing revision. A later report/doc-only commit may package
  the unchanged producing code, but must not mislabel the source of predictions or token usage.

```text
python code/evaluation/run_eval.py --split all --out runs/corrective/0021_after.csv

python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'code');from ghostaudit.validate import cli;cli()" output.csv --diagnostics code/evaluation/final_run/diagnostics.jsonl
python code/evaluation/make_reports.py --final-manifest code/evaluation/final_run/manifest.json
python code/tools/make_zip.py

```

Run the full suite once after runtime changes settle; repeat only when a subsequent change/failure warrants it.
Stage newly generated allowed artifact files before make_zip.py (it selects tracked/staged code files); inspect
the staged paths so caches, `.env`, dataset and unrelated files never enter the package. Record the clean-room
commands and results in status.md. Do not call report/zip generation successful solely because old files exist.

1	"""Deterministic output writer: canonical step order, consecutive step_no, compact sorted-key JSON."""
     2	from __future__ import annotations
     3	
     4	import csv
     5	import json
     6	from pathlib import Path
     7	
     8	from ghostaudit.models import OP_ORDER, Status, Step, case_key
     9	
    10	OUTPUT_HEADER = ["case_id", "deletion_status", "steps_json"]
    11	
    12	
    13	def canonical(steps: list[Step]) -> list[Step]:
    14	    ordered = sorted(steps, key=lambda s: (OP_ORDER[s.operation], s.system_id, s.resource_id))
    15	    return [step.model_copy(update={"step_no": number}) for number, step in enumerate(ordered, start=1)]
    16	
    17	
    18	def dumps_steps(steps: list[Step]) -> str:
    19	    return json.dumps([step.model_dump(mode="json") for step in canonical(steps)],
    20	                      sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
    21	
    22	
    23	def write_output(rows: list[tuple[str, Status, list[Step]]], path: Path) -> None:
    24	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    25	    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    26	        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator="\n")
    27	        writer.writerow(OUTPUT_HEADER)
    28	        for case_id, status, steps in sorted(rows, key=lambda row: case_key(row[0])):
    29	            writer.writerow([case_id, Status(status).value, dumps_steps(steps)])

     2	
     3	Excludes .env, caches, runs/, __pycache__, nested archives and anything under dataset/; requires both evaluation
     4	reports; fails if any file contains a key-like string or the value of a provider credential from the environment.
     5	"""
     6	from __future__ import annotations
     7	
     8	import os
     9	import re
    10	import subprocess
    11	import sys
    12	import zipfile
    13	from pathlib import Path
    14	
    15	REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    16	OUTPUT = REPO_ROOT / "code.zip"
    17	REQUIRED = ("evaluation/evaluation_report.md", "evaluation/usage_report.md", "README.md", "main.py",
    18	            "requirements.txt")
    19	EXCLUDED_PARTS = {".cache", "runs", "__pycache__", "dataset", ".pytest_cache"}
    20	SECRET_PATTERNS = [re.compile(p) for p in (
    21	    r"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}", r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}", r"Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{20,}",
    22	    r"(?i)(api[_-]?key|secret|password|access[_-]?token)[ \t]*[:=][ \t]*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9_\-+/]{16,}")]

# Interview notes — Ghost Data Still Exists

## 1. Architecture in one paragraph

**Code decides, models read.** A deterministic Python engine (`code/ghostaudit/`) owns identity, evidence parsing,
discovery, state at `audit_at`, policy, the COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE decision, step generation, citation and ordering. Models
are called at three bounded points through one shared layer (`ghostaudit/llm/`: cache → call → pydantic validation →
one repair retry → usage ledger) and only return typed facts:

| Point | Model | Returns | Calls in the final run |
|---|---|---|---|
| Request intent | TypeSafe Jev (Choice), Azure gpt-6-luna adjudicates disagreements | label in DELETION/ACCESS/CORRECTION/EXPORT/OPT_OUT/OTHER | 518 Jev + 3 Azure |
| PNG screenshots | Gemini 3.8 Flash via Strands | `VisionRecord` rows, regex/identity revalidated | 11 |
| Category fallback (no record field/table/event maps the resource) | Jev (Choice) | one of the data categories, accepted at p ≥ 0.5 | 3 |

Pipeline per request: intent gate → identity at the cutoff → exact-identifier discovery + grounded account link →
state per resource → policy obligations → plan → canonical serialization → validator.

## 2. Investigation approach

- **Strict cutoff.** A file counts only if its manifest `captured_at ≤ audit_at` (lines inside a later file are ignored
  even when dated earlier); activity and audit rows by `event_time`. Post-cutoff identity values are never read.
- **Identity.** Current snapshot (if updated before the cutoff) + every pre-cutoff audit value; sha256 of every email;
  exact per-type matching (emails/hashes case-insensitive, phone digits, NFC names). A **name never links on its own**
  (decoys: "Jonas Berg" vs "Jonas Berglund").
- **Evidence ledger.** SQL snapshots (primary/replica tables, generic stores with `record_json`), JSON exports and
  snapshot bundles, six log formats grouped by trace id (the lookup key and the resource id sit on different lines),
  a handover text, PDFs and vision rows become `Observation`s; full tables/collections also become
  `SnapshotCoverage` (an empty collection still proves absence).
- **Grounded account link.** An account belongs to the subject only if one eligible record carries a subject identifier
  and the account id (readback trace, export lookup with a profile, history `record_lookup`, catalog link, reference
  edge). Workflow timing only **ranks** candidates for diagnostics. 20/32 samples (342/508 deletion requests) have no
  grounded link: they carry `ACCOUNT_UNGROUNDED` and can never be COMPLETE.
- **State.** Latest establishing observation; observed absence (404, rows=0, NOT_FOUND) is cited as observed; otherwise
  absence by snapshot omission (drop snapshots superseded by the last DELETE claim; latest replica-covering one, else
  latest; and a record last seen in a replica needs a snapshot of that replica); state-check activity only as a last
  resort. Operational claims ("DELETE_RECORD SUCCESS") never set state.

## 3. Remediation planning

"""Promote a validated full-run candidate to the selected release (spec 0021). No inference runs here.

python code/tools/finalize_run.py --candidate-manifest runs/corrective/0021_candidate.manifest.json \\
    --evaluation-inputs code/evaluation/corrective_run/evaluation_inputs.json

Checks the candidate (default configuration, committed producing code, hashes, validator with its diagnostics) and the
same-revision evaluation inputs, renders both reports, stages every file, and only then replaces
code/evaluation/final_run/, the reports and output.csv (output last). The replacement is a sequence of renames, not
one atomic operation: an interruption stops with the run id and the location of the previous bundle.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

CODE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REPO_ROOT = CODE_DIR.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(CODE_DIR))
sys.path.insert(0, str(CODE_DIR / "evaluation"))

import make_reports  # noqa: E402
import score  # noqa: E402
from ghostaudit.llm.ledger import load_rows  # noqa: E402
from ghostaudit.loaders import Dataset, load_dataset  # noqa: E402
from ghostaudit.provenance import sha256_of  # noqa: E402
from ghostaudit.validate import validate_output  # noqa: E402

FINAL_RUN_DIRECTORY = "code/evaluation/final_run"
REPORT_NAMES = ("evaluation_report.md", "usage_report.md")


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise SystemExit(f"finalize_run: {message}")


def checked_candidate_files(candidate: dict, dataset: Dataset) -> dict[str, Path]:
    """The candidate must be the published default configuration of committed code, intact and valid."""
    args = candidate["args"]
    if args.get("case"):
        fail(f"candidate {candidate['run_id']} is a --case subset, not a full run")
    if args.get("ablate") or args.get("ungrounded_account_steps") != "none" or args.get("offline"):
        fail(f"candidate {candidate['run_id']} is not the default configuration: {args}")
    if candidate.get("uncommitted_producing_code") != []:
        fail(f"candidate {candidate['run_id']} ran uncommitted producing code: {candidate.get('uncommitted_producing_code')}")
    if not candidate.get("published"):
        fail(f"candidate {candidate['run_id']} failed its own validation and was not published")
    files = {role: Path(candidate[role]) for role in ("output", "diagnostics", "usage_ledger")}
    for role, path in files.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            fail(f"candidate {role} is missing: {path}")
        if sha256_of(path) != candidate[f"{role}_sha256"]:
            fail(f"candidate {role} {path} does not match its recorded sha256")
    validation = validate_output(files["output"], dataset, files["diagnostics"])
    if not validation.ok:
        fail(f"candidate fails validation with its diagnostics: {validation.errors[:5]}")
    return files


def finalize(candidate_manifest_path: Path, evaluation_inputs_path: Path, repository_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
             dataset: Dataset | None = None) -> dict:
    if not candidate_manifest_path.is_file():
        fail(f"candidate manifest is missing: {candidate_manifest_path}")
    candidate = json.loads(candidate_manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    files = checked_candidate_files(candidate, dataset or load_dataset(repository_root / "dataset"))
    gold = score.read_rows(repository_root / "dataset" / "sample_output.csv")
    inputs = make_reports.load_evaluation_inputs(evaluation_inputs_path, gold)
    if inputs["code_revision"] != candidate["git_revision"]:
        fail(f"evaluation inputs revision {inputs['code_revision']} != candidate revision {candidate['git_revision']}; "
             "capture the evaluation inputs from the same frozen code")
    run_id = candidate["run_id"]
    selected_manifest = {
        "run_id": run_id, "git_revision": candidate["git_revision"], "args": candidate["args"],
        "rows": candidate["rows"], "output_sha256": candidate["output_sha256"],
        "diagnostics": f"{FINAL_RUN_DIRECTORY}/diagnostics.jsonl", "diagnostics_sha256": candidate["diagnostics_sha256"],
        "usage_ledger": f"{FINAL_RUN_DIRECTORY}/usage_ledger.jsonl",
        "usage_ledger_sha256": candidate["usage_ledger_sha256"], "usage_overall": candidate["usage_overall"],
        "validation": candidate["validation"],
        "evaluation_inputs": evaluation_inputs_path.resolve().relative_to(repository_root.resolve()).as_posix(),
        "original_paths": {"manifest": str(candidate_manifest_path), "output": candidate["output"],
                           "diagnostics": candidate["diagnostics"], "usage_ledger": candidate["usage_ledger"]},
        "promoted_to": "output.csv (repository root)"}
    final = {"manifest": selected_manifest, "output": files["output"],
             "diagnostics": score.read_diagnostics(files["diagnostics"]), "usage_rows": load_rows(files["usage_ledger"])}
    reports = {"evaluation_report.md": make_reports.evaluation_report(final, inputs, gold, unified=True),
               "usage_report.md": make_reports.usage_report(final)}

    staging = repository_root / f".finalize_{run_id}"
    shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
    (staging / "final_run").mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(files["diagnostics"], staging / "final_run" / "diagnostics.jsonl")
    shutil.copyfile(files["usage_ledger"], staging / "final_run" / "usage_ledger.jsonl")
    (staging / "final_run" / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(selected_manifest, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
                                                         encoding="utf-8")
    for name, text in reports.items():
        (staging / name).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    shutil.copyfile(files["output"], staging / "output.csv")

    final_run_directory = repository_root / FINAL_RUN_DIRECTORY
    previous = final_run_directory.with_name(f"final_run.previous_{run_id}")
    try:
        if final_run_directory.exists():
            os.replace(final_run_directory, previous)
        os.replace(staging / "final_run", final_run_directory)
        for name in REPORT_NAMES:
            os.replace(staging / name, final_run_directory.parent / name)
        os.replace(staging / "output.csv", repository_root / "output.csv")
    except OSError as error:
        fail(f"publication of {run_id} was interrupted ({error}); previous final_run kept at {previous}, staged files "
             f"at {staging}; the last committed release is the recovery point")
    published = make_reports.load_final_run(final_run_directory / "manifest.json", repository_root)
    for role in ("diagnostics", "usage_ledger"):
        if sha256_of(repository_root / selected_manifest[role]) != selected_manifest[f"{role}_sha256"]:
            fail(f"published {role} does not match the candidate's sha256")
    rerendered = {"evaluation_report.md": make_reports.evaluation_report(published, inputs, gold, unified=True),
                  "usage_report.md": make_reports.usage_report(published)}
    if any((final_run_directory.parent / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8") != text for name, text in rerendered.items()):
        fail("published reports differ from a re-render of the published bundle")
    shutil.rmtree(previous, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
    return selected_manifest


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evaluation-inputs", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    manifest = finalize(args.candidate_manifest, args.evaluation_inputs)
    print(f"selected run {manifest['run_id']} (code {manifest['git_revision']}, output sha256 "
          f"{manifest['output_sha256']}) published to output.csv and {FINAL_RUN_DIRECTORY}/ with both reports")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
